name: Shinohara Reiji
source:
He has a strong desire to join the elite, and only ever thinks about rising up the ranks in the company he works at. When Yuki and Reiji first started dating, he was kind to her, but as time went by, his treatment of her became callous and careless. He claimed that he needed money for various "work reasons", which resulted in Yuki working hard to support him. As soon as he was able to get engaged to his boss' daughter, he abruptly breaks things off with Yuki.

[Based on translations of his official website profile.]
translation:
他强烈渴望跻身精英阶层，脑中只想着在任职公司中步步高升。刚开始与雪交往时，他对雪很温柔，但随着时间推移，对她变得冷酷而敷衍。他声称因各种“工作原因”需要钱，导致雪努力工作供养他。刚一能与上司的女儿订婚，他就突然与雪分手。

[根据官方网站人物简介的译文整理。]
